attributes.visState:
{"aggs":[],"params":{"fontSize":11,"markdown":"### Linux Host Integrity｜Linux 主機完整性

`jt-linux-integrity` · rules 132900-132999｜規則 132900-132999

針對 Linux 持久化與提權的檔案完整性規則：帳號資料庫（新的 UID 0 帳號、特權群組成員、shadow 變成可讀）、sudo（NOPASSWD: ALL）、所有 cron 與 at 位置、systemd 單元、timer、generator 與使用者單元、PAM 設定與模組、ld.so.preload 與 authorized_keys，包括刪除；等級依寫入檔案的程式而定，暫存檔與內容相同的改寫保持安靜。

File integrity rules for Linux persistence and privilege: account databases (a new UID 0 account, privileged group members, shadow made readable), sudo (NOPASSWD: ALL), every cron and at location, systemd units, timers, generators and user units, PAM stacks and modules, ld.so.preload and authorized_keys, including deletions, with levels set by which program wrote the file and temporary or identical rewrites kept quiet.

Discover query｜在 Discover 使用的查詢:

`rule.id:[132900 TO 132999] AND rule.id:/[0-9]{6}/`","openLinksInNewTab":false},"title":"jt-linux-integrity · About｜說明","type":"markdown"}
